selected_role_profiles.label: Economist and Policy Analyst
selected_role_profiles.cv_angle: Economist with strong quantitative and data skills, focused on evidence-based policy analysis.
selected_role_profiles.cover_letter_angle: Emphasize the link between economic reasoning, quantitative methods and public decision-making.

selected_skill_blocks.label: Econometrics
selected_skill_blocks.short: Applied econometrics to analyze data, test relationships and support public policy evaluation.
selected_skill_blocks.medium: Regressions, panel data, difference-in-differences, Stata, R, quantitative analysis and interpretation.
evidence: Dauphine: applied econometrics, Stata/R, regressions, panels and evaluation.
Structural gravity project and applied economics.

selected_skill_blocks.label: Public policy analysis
selected_skill_blocks.short: Data-driven public policy analysis based on indicators, evidence and decision-oriented synthesis.
selected_skill_blocks.medium: Turning data and quantitative methods into diagnosis, indicators, notes, limitations and careful recommendations.
evidence: Dauphine: public economics, evaluation and quantitative analysis.
DataForGood / Reclaim Finance: territorial indicators to support public decision-making.

selected_skill_blocks.label: Climate policy
selected_skill_blocks.short: Climate transition analysis connecting data, public policy, carbon accounting and economic issues.
selected_skill_blocks.medium: Applied climate policy: carbon reporting, territorial adaptation, industrial transition, CBAM/MACF and economic instruments.
evidence: Greenly: carbon data and GHG methodologies.
Master thesis on green industrial transition and MACF / CBAM note.
DataForGood / Reclaim Finance: fiscal vulnerability to climate risks.

selected_skill_blocks.label: Writing and synthesis
selected_skill_blocks.short: Writing syntheses, notes and documentation that connect data, method and decision-making.
selected_skill_blocks.medium: Policy notes, methodology documentation, operational guides, structured arguments and audience adaptation.
evidence: Policy notes, methodology documentation, Notion guides and Greenly materials.
AFD biodiversity note and MACF / CBAM note.

selected_skill_blocks.label: Data structuring and cleaning
selected_skill_blocks.short: Structuring and cleaning multi-source data to produce reliable and documented datasets.
selected_skill_blocks.medium: Central skill covering cleaning, normalization, schema harmonization, variable dictionaries and quality checks.
evidence: Greenly: purchases, freight, recycling, sold products and emission factors.
DataForGood / Reclaim Finance: variable dictionary, schema normalization and quality checks.

selected_skill_blocks.label: R for statistics
selected_skill_blocks.short: R for statistical analysis, applied econometrics, visualization and reproducible reporting.
selected_skill_blocks.medium: R in academic work with tidyverse, ggplot2, dplyr, plm, caret and R Markdown.
evidence: Dauphine: econometrics, statistics, visualization and applied projects in R.
Difference-in-differences, panel data and applied economics in an academic setting.

selected_skill_blocks.label: Python data
selected_skill_blocks.short: Python to structure, clean, transform and document large datasets.
selected_skill_blocks.medium: Python for Excel/CSV ingestion, transformations, quality checks, documentation and Parquet conversion.
evidence: DataForGood / Reclaim Finance: Python pipeline, DuckDB, Excel/CSV ingestion, Parquet conversion and data dictionary.
Quality checks on a fiscal dataset covering French municipalities.

selected_skill_blocks.label: Competition and regulation
selected_skill_blocks.short: Economic analysis transferable to competition, regulation and market structure topics.
selected_skill_blocks.medium: Frame as interest and transferable economic analysis: markets, incentives, regulation, data and synthesis.
evidence: Training in industrial economics and economic analysis.
Competition-related interest and applications, with transferable quantitative analysis skills.
